summary: Google DeepMind released a patch (v0.6.1) for the AlphaGenome library with a plotting speedup and several bug fixes.

practices.reason: Bug fixes and a plotting speedup in a genomics library change what a team using AlphaGenome should update to, but create no significant integration work.
practices.quote:
Filter splice junctions when calling `filter_by_strand` of model Output
    dataclass. Previously only tracks would be correctly filtered.
